description: External, never-trained-on test: electric scooter riding + controlled overturn/collision sessions (Sanchez-Iborra, Bernal-Escobedo & Santa 2025, Zenodo jsanta-upct/scooter-riding v1.1, CC BY 4.0). Evaluated with the ALREADY DEPLOYED Model A (classifier + reconstruction + exact OR-fusion rule) and Model B -- no retraining, no threshold recalibration.
source_citation: Sanchez-Iborra, R., Bernal-Escobedo, L., & Santa, J. (2025). Dataset on personal mobility vehicle's regular riding and fall events. Data in Brief, 61, 111681. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2025.111681. Data: Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14887437 (CC BY 4.0, verified via the Zenodo API).
second_candidate_dataset_finding: The advisor's second-ranked dataset (Boubezoul et al. 2019, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103828, motorcycle fall/critical-events) was checked BEFORE any download and found to be byte-signature-identical (1000 Hz sampling, exact column names/units, exact scenario names) to this project's own data/fall/ and data/near-fall/ folders, which are already part of the FROZEN TRAINING snapshot (datasets_used/). It is NOT independent data and cannot be used as an external test set here -- using it would silently re-test the model on its own training data. Not used; reported as a finding rather than silently skipped.
vehicle_domain_note: Electric scooter with a phone-based on-board unit, not a helmet-mounted motorcycle IMU -- closer to HelmX's two-wheeler domain than car-based sources (CARLA, STRIDE) already used elsewhere in this project, but not an exact sensor-placement match.
